description: Learning Centres Affected by Road Closures is a dataset listed in Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX), an open data portal, published or maintained by Cox's Bazar Education Sector. Pcodes and information on road closures and affected learning centres. Coverage: Bangladesh. The portal files it under the publisher Cox's Bazar Education Sector. Its tags are education, education facilities-schools, roads. It offers 2 resource(s) in PDF, XLSX. The portal shows 2025-04-25 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution International (CC BY). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hdx-humanitarian-data-exchange.
